channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Adirondack Forest Rangers completed multiple rescues this week, saving stranded and injured hikers on Mount Colden, Cascade Mountain, and Mount Marcy. They also contained a twenty-one-acre fire caused by an illegal campfire near Indian Lake. Authorities remind visitors to prepare properly before entering the backcountry.

The Bus is celebrating fifty years of service in the Rutland region. Marble Valley Regional Transit District runs nearly fifty vehicles across ten routes, partnering with local businesses and healthcare providers. They’re planning upgrades including hybrid buses and new rider support programs.

Rutland is updating the way it replaces police cruisers, now factoring in idling time as part of mileage wear. One hour of idling equals thirty miles of driving, officials say. The policy change awaits final approval by the city and state.

A Poultney man has been convicted of multiple sexual assault charges involving a child. William Rice Jr. faces life in prison for his crimes, a Rutland County court ruled. Sentencing will be determined in the coming months.
